listings.body:
rustup --version
rustc --version
cargo --version
git --version
Get-Command rustup, rustc, cargo, git
rustup show

sudo apt update
sudo apt install build-essential curl git python3
sudo dnf install gcc gcc-c++ make curl git python3
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh

. "$HOME/.cargo/env"
rustc --version
cargo --version
git --version
command -v cargo
rustup show

rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal
rustup component add --toolchain 1.95.0 rustfmt clippy rust-src
cargo +1.95.0 --version

[toolchain]
channel = "1.95.0"
components = ["clippy", "rustfmt", "rust-src"]
profile = "minimal"

cargo +1.95.0 new first-steps --edition 2024
cd first-steps
cargo +1.95.0 run
winget install -e --id ZedIndustries.Zed

cargo +1.95.0 fmt
cargo +1.95.0 clippy --all-targets
cargo +1.95.0 test
cargo test -p first-steps --locked

git clone https://github.com/franmolmedo/rust-a-fondo-codigo.git
cd rust-a-fondo-codigo

cargo run -p first-steps --locked
cargo test -p first-steps --locked
python verify.py

bolt,2
nut,3
bolt,4

cargo test -p rust-appendix-lab data::tests --locked
cargo test -p rust-appendix-lab --doc --locked

cargo test -p rust-appendix-lab const_eval::tests --locked
cargo test -p rust-appendix-lab --doc --locked

$env:RUST_BACKTRACE = "1"
cargo run -p rust-appendix-lab --example debug_preview -- --broken
Remove-Item Env:RUST_BACKTRACE
RUST_BACKTRACE=1 cargo run -p rust-appendix-lab --example debug_preview -- --broken

cargo test -p rust-appendix-lab performance::tests --locked
cargo run -p rust-appendix-lab --example debug_preview --locked

rustc --version --verbose
cargo test -p rust-appendix-lab performance::tests --release --locked
cargo run -p rust-appendix-lab --example measure_lookup --release --locked

[profile.profiling]
inherits = "release"
debug = 2
strip = "none"
cargo build -p rust-appendix-lab --example measure_lookup --profile profiling --locked

rustup toolchain install nightly-2026-04-15 --profile minimal --component miri,rust-src
cargo +nightly-2026-04-15 miri setup
cargo +nightly-2026-04-15 miri test -p rust-appendix-lab --lib --locked audits::tests
cargo +nightly-2026-04-15 miri run -p rust-appendix-lab --example miri_bad_read --locked
python advanced.py --miri
cargo test -p appendix-loom-model --release --locked

rustup toolchain install nightly-2026-04-15 --profile minimal
cargo +nightly-2026-04-15 install cargo-fuzz --version 0.13.1 --locked
cargo +nightly-2026-04-15 fuzz run parse_record -- -max_total_time=30 -max_len=1024
cargo test -p native-checksum --locked

cargo new --lib lab --name rust-appendix-lab --vcs none
cargo new --bin inventory-cli --vcs none
cargo new --lib sum-service --vcs none

[workspace]
members = ["lab", "inventory-cli", "sum-service"]
resolver = "3"

[workspace.package]
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"
license = "MIT"
authors = ["Francisco M. Olmedo Bueno"]
publish = false

[workspace.lints.rust]
unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn = "deny"
unused_must_use = "deny"

[workspace.lints.clippy]
undocumented_unsafe_blocks = "deny"
cargo run -p inventory-cli --locked -- inventory-cli/fixtures/inventory.csv

adaptador,4
cable,7
cargo run -p inventory-cli --locked -- inventory-cli/fixtures/invalid.csv

cargo test -p rust-appendix-lab data::tests --locked
cargo test -p inventory-cli --locked
cargo run -p sum-service --bin sum-server --locked
cargo run -p sum-service --bin sum-client --locked -- 19 23
cargo run -p sum-service --bin sum-client --locked -- 18446744073709551615 1
cargo test -p sum-service --locked

cargo test --workspace --release --locked
cargo build -p inventory-cli -p sum-service --bins --release --locked
python package.py --version 0.1.0

[features]
default = []
alloc = []

cargo test -p portable-core --locked
cargo test -p portable-core --features alloc --locked

rustup target add thumbv7em-none-eabihf --toolchain 1.95.0
cargo build -p portable-core --lib --target thumbv7em-none-eabihf --locked
cargo build -p portable-core --lib --features alloc --target thumbv7em-none-eabihf --locked
